deterministic_counterexample.erasure_selection: all fragments of first logical datagram and the same number of its FEC-block parity shards
deterministic_counterexample.method_scope: actual LINK Fragmenter/FECPath/size-class encoder/decoder/Reassembler synthetic event timeline with targeted not random loss

mechanical_implication: Under 8ms closure, per-class blocks may contain only first datagram's fragments. At 100ms, later sources in same class increase number of independent parity equations. Equal wire losses can be recoverable only in latter; 8ms is lower parity latency, not universally stronger loss resilience.
nonimplications: This is NOT the measured random 20% netem erasure pattern from Actions37907829434
This is NOT proof E1 scheduler is the unique cause of high UDP loss
This is NOT a reason to change all lanes to 100ms and violate lowRTT sparse timing
